original_test_intent: Run NCCL all-reduce and all-to-all across the intended eight GPUs for message sizes from 8 bytes through 8 GiB in factor-two steps, and compare collective bandwidth/error results with the matching DA/Viking topology reference.
original_method: Pin NCCL and nccl-tests commits/binaries and build flags; map eight GPU UUID/BDF/ranks and topology; validate CUDA/driver/compiler, environment, P2P/fabric and 8G memory fit; preserve baseline/isolate jobs; build reproducibly; run two tracked collectives with timeout and telemetry; retain every size row and error; compare alg/bus bandwidth per collective; clean contexts and verify links/logs.
manual_activity: Fabric owner supplies pinned stack/topology/references and approves eight-GPU load; operator isolates the node and owns recovery; agent may build/run both tracked collectives.
required_inputs: Pinned NCCL/nccl-tests sources or binaries and hashes/build flags
Compatible driver/CUDA/compiler/MPI if applicable and environment variables
Memory budget for 8G sweep and per-size timeout
DA/Viking all-reduce and all-to-all alg/bus bandwidth/error references
Isolation, telemetry limits and link/GPU recovery approval
safety_requirements: Do not clone moving HEAD or modify shared NCCL/CUDA installation
Never infer rank order from GPU ordinals
Preflight eight-GPU memory and peer access
Abort on NCCL hang/error, XID, link degradation or thermal/power fault
No GPU reset, retry or runtime change without engineer control
agent_execution_scope: Build approved nccl-tests and run both exact commands
Collect every size/metric/error plus telemetry and cleanup
engineer_actions: Approve artifacts, rank topology, resource boundary and oracles
Own fabric/GPU recovery and anomaly disposition

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an immutable rank/topology manifest and compare per-size algBW, busBW and errors separately for both collectives while correlating link telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes GPU ordering, resource feasibility and reference matching reproducible.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One aggregate multi-GPU bandwidth value cannot replace both collective curves from 8 bytes to 8 GiB.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An 8G maximum can stress memory and fabric and NCCL hangs may leave child processes; bounded watchdog and OOB visibility are necessary.

project_override_considerations: Fabric owner defines NCCL environment/topology overrides, canonical bandwidth field and allowed variance per collective/size.

Algorithm/bus bandwidth and error comparison to DA/Viking
dmesg/XID/AER/NVLink/BMC/SEL deltas, cleanup/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines the two NCCL collectives and exact sweep; the malformed step numbering/build typo is resolvable against pinned nccl-tests and does not introduce a competing test intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Stack, topology and references are provisionable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores complete collective curves, explicit eight-GPU rank topology and reproducible stack/reference evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: All-reduce and all-to-all stress different communication patterns, so one cannot stand in for the other. GPU rank order and topology influence ring/tree paths and bandwidth. The 8 GiB upper point also changes memory pressure and may expose hangs not visible at small sizes; per-size algBW/busBW and link/error evidence are required to distinguish performance from transport failure.
